description: Honor approved plans and accept Chinese planning documents
changelog:
**Fixes:**
- After approval of the latest final plan, the main AI validates artifacts and activates the task without duplicate confirmation.
- Task Basis and PRD validation accept Chinese, English and bilingual headings, numbering and nested sections while retaining substantive evidence checks.
- Ecochain marketplace workflow variants use the same approval handoff and are published from the team-owned fork.
notes: Upgrade @ecochain/trellis, run trellis update in each project and restart the session. Existing approval remains valid for format-only repairs. No --migrate required.
